experiment: 023-attr-detector-emb (D-018 cycle; docs/08 H-A5 + docs/09 pre-registration). Penultimate embeddings of 4 published detectors fed to the EXACT H-A1 probe (experiments/020-attr-foundation/run.py, imported). All constants frozen before any embedding was read.
image_pipeline: data/processed/fov512/images/<sha>.png (512x512 crop, identical for every class) -> lib/perturb.apply_condition(img, cond, key=sha256, seed=0) (same code path as 004 feature extraction) -> detector's own test transform (taken unmodified from experiments/002-baselines/scorers/*.py)

ha1_probe.module: experiments/020-attr-foundation/run.py (imported by path; functions make_folds, closed_task, logo_task, eval_closed, eval_logo, cluster_weights, gates, MahaModel are reused unchanged)
ha1_probe.note: same rows/order/groups/folds as 020 ha1_main: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle, seed 0) on caption-family groups; inner 3-fold grouped CV picks C on the primary condition (train folds only); LR(max_iter=300, class_weight=balanced) on standardised features; C grid = 020 dino grid for every embedding

commfor.hook: forward_pre_hook on vit.head: input = pooled 384-d feature (after fc_norm)

bfree.hook: forward_pre_hook on model.head: input = pooled CLS feature; 5-window forward averages the 5 windows
bfree.transform: full image -> ToTensor -> norm (no resize); windows tiled/cropped to 36x36 tokens

rine.arch: CLIP ViT-L/14 per-block CLS stack (24 x 1024) -> TIE -> proj2 (LDM checkpoint)
rine.hook: forward hook on proj2: output z = the 1024-d vector fed to the head

clipdet.arch: open_clip ViT-L/14 CommonPool, visual.proj=None (next-to-last), L2-normalised, ChannelLinear head (latent10k_plus)
clipdet.hook: forward_pre_hook on fc: input = 1024-d L2-normalised feature

extract.oom_retry: halve batch on torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError (never fall back to CPU silently)

d008.rule: ok if scaled embedding diff <= tol OR logit diff <= tol (brief); both recorded; abort if not ok

boot.ci: percentile 95%, cluster = caption family (020 cluster_weights, same weights for every embedding => paired)

perm.note: 020 ha1_main perm tolerances; label-permuted fixed-C T-mix pipeline at the primary condition, per embedding

label_rule.text: H-A5 (docs/08): PASS if best detector embedding bacc at jpeg75_resize05 >= H-A1 best layer + 0.05 AND paired family-bootstrap CI lower bound (diff) > 0. KILL if best detector embedding bacc <= H-A1 best layer. Else INCONCLUSIVE. INVALID if a validity gate fails.
label_rule.ha1_best_layer_headline: max point bacc over the four fixed H-A1 feature sets b4/b8/b12/cat (T-mix, jpeg75_resize05), computed here with the identical imported pipeline; the 020 nested-choice value is reported alongside
label_rule.best_embedding: argmax point bacc over the 4 detectors (same condition, T-mix); per-detector paired diffs and Holm-adjusted bootstrap p also reported (descriptive)
label_rule.open_set_flag: mean LOGO AUROC >= 0.80 and min >= 0.65 (msp or maha), descriptive for H-A5

overlap_flags.source: kb/papers/communityforensics-cvpr2025.md, bfree-cvpr2025.md, clipdet-cvprw2024.md, rine-eccv2024.md; exact checkpoint lists are not public in our KB -> flags are family-level and marked [unverified] where so

commfor.dalle3: no known overlap (eval-set generator in paper)
commfor.firefly: no known overlap (eval-set generator in paper)
commfor.midjourney-v5: no known overlap (eval-set generator in paper)
commfor.stable-diffusion-2: LIKELY family overlap: 4,763 HF latent-diffusion models (SD-family checkpoints/finetunes) [exact SD2 overlap unverified]
commfor.stable-diffusion-xl: POSSIBLE family overlap: HF diffusers models incl. SDXL derivatives [unverified]
commfor.flux: no known overlap (FLUX is an eval generator in the paper)

bfree.stable-diffusion-2: OVERLAP: trained on SD 2.1 inpainting regenerations (same decoder/VAE family; SD2 vs SD2.1 inpainting version [unverified])
bfree.sd3_large: none (these sd3/flux images are B-Free's own extended-Synthbuster EVAL release)

rine.note: LDM checkpoint: trained on LDM data from Corvi et al. (DMimageDetection); CLIP backbone frozen (OpenAI)
rine.stable-diffusion-2: FAMILY overlap (latent diffusion), not the same generator

clipdet.note: head trained on 10k real/Latent-Diffusion pairs (COCO captions); backbone CommonPool CLIP
